hero.badge: Live platform · GPS tracking & payments active
hero.desc: MoveSpot is the marketplace connecting advertisers and vehicle owners — food trucks, vans, taxis, ride-hail, delivery scooters. You draw your zone, the budget is calculated per km², and every kilometre broadcast is proven by GPS.
hero.stat0_v: per km² per day ($2.70 in major cities)
hero.stat1_v: per vehicle per day — from $375/month for 1 vehicle

features.item0_d: Draw your broadcast polygon; the area and budget are calculated automatically, with a density surcharge in urban areas.
features.item1_d: GPS positions sent in batches then aggregated: real kilometres, active minutes, and coverage rate for your zone.
features.item2_d: Card payment, subscription with a 14-day trial, prepaid wallet, or bank transfer for B2B budgets.
features.item3_d: SIRET-verified, signed vehicle QR codes, installation validated with 4 photos, two-factor auth, and human moderation.

nouveau.desc: Your vehicle will be verified by MoveSpot before appearing on the marketplace.
nouveau.autre_type_placeholder: e.g. Rickshaw, river boat, brewery truck…
nouveau.autre_type_hint: This detail is visible to advertisers and helps MoveSpot validate your vehicle.
nouveau.condition_warning: ⚠️ The declared condition is verified from photos by our AI and confirmed by MoveSpot. Any false declaration results in rejection.
nouveau.condition_excellent_desc: Flawless bodywork, as good as new
nouveau.condition_bon_desc: Minor signs of use, clean and well-maintained
nouveau.id_section_title: Vehicle identification — visible to the installer
nouveau.id_section_desc: This information allows the installer to identify your vehicle precisely on the ground.
nouveau.description_placeholder: Describe your vehicle, its condition, its specific features…
nouveau.description_hint: No need to mention advertising formats: advertisers choose what they want to wrap.
nouveau.price_hint: Enter your net owner remuneration, not the price paid by the advertiser. The AI estimate shows the advertiser market price; your price is 70% of that (MoveSpot keeps a 30% commission).
nouveau.photos_hint: Photos must reflect the vehicle's actual condition — the real state is automatically verified.
nouveau.photos_3d_hint: 💡 Advertisers use a 3D simulator to preview their advertising wrap on your vehicle from your photos. The clearer and more representative they are, the better their preview — and the more likely your vehicle is to be selected.
nouveau.estimate_desc: Verifies the photo and suggests a realistic price.

nouveau.estimate_ai_upload: Please upload an authentic photo of the vehicle.
nouveau.estimate_commission: MoveSpot keeps a 30% brokerage commission. Enter a price within this range.
nouveau.ip_notice: 📜 Intellectual property: by publishing this vehicle and its photos, you certify that you hold the rights and agree to comply with French and European intellectual property law (copyright, trademarks, image rights). Advertising visuals broadcast by advertisers are solely their responsibility.

nouveau.error_autre_desc: Please specify the vehicle type in the dedicated field.

Your owner remuneration is 70% of that, i.e. {{ownerMin}}–{{ownerMax}} €/day. Enter at most {{ownerMax}} €/day (use the 'Use {{ownerMax}} €/day' button in the AI Estimate box).

qr.title: Vehicle QR codes
qr.description: Print and stick the QR in each vehicle's cabin. The driver scans it with their phone to start GPS tracking — no installation required. QR codes are cryptographically signed (HMAC-SHA256): impossible to forge.
qr.expiry_expires: Generated QR codes will expire on {{date}}. After this date, the driver will see an error when scanning.
qr.expiry_never: QR codes will never expire — ideal for permanent stickers in the cabin.
qr.instruction_4: 4. Confirm the vehicle and start GPS
qr.print_footer: Generated by MoveSpot · movespot.fr · These QR codes are cryptographically signed — any modification invalidates them.
